title: Review hazardous-material employee training evidence
normalized_text: A qualified reviewer would assess whether the relevant hazmat-employee training requirement and current training evidence under 49 CFR 172.704 apply to the identified function.

citations.notes: Fixture-level pinpoint for training review; functional role and recurrence details are not inferred.

actions: review training requirement and retained evidence
conditions: when the individual performs a covered hazmat function
notes: The source and rule screen do not establish training completion or compliance.
